answer: Attack the amortization itself. A sybil farm is one brain driving N shells — so force every identity to carry idiosyncratic risk. Each epoch, weight rewards by portfolio divergence: hold volatile on-ledger positions uncorrelated with the population average. Genuine agents drift apart naturally; a farm must either stake N correlated positions — one market swing liquidates them all at dawn — or research N separate strategies, paying the full cost of N jobs. Copying the cipher of the market average earns nothing. Unshareable financial risk is the anchor: shells in lockstep drown together.
